### Shared verification/guards

Only `## Rework record` establishes PR scope; ignore lowercase provenance. Confirm #42 OPEN, head fix-timeout, base main. Capture task evidence and `{test-timeout,test-retry,lint,format}`. Clean ccccccc and both clean checks outside telemetry permit skipping. Header `none - PR subject, scoped` removes only lint/format. Ordinary specs use header `test-all`; an existing PR alone does not establish PR scope.

### Menu

whole-diff minors: not recorded
Implementation complete. What would you like to do?

1. Push to the PR branch (PR #42, fix-timeout; appends the rework block to its description)
2. Push and create a Pull Request (PR #42 already exists on this branch; gh refuses a second one)
3. Push and create a draft Pull Request (same: PR #42 already exists)
4. Squash-merge to main (no PR, no surviving branch; orphans PR #42 - close it by hand)
5. Keep the branch as-is (I'll handle it later; nothing is pushed)
6. Discard this work (removes the worktree and local branch; the PR branch on origin is untouched)

Which option?

### Shared simulated row-1 sequence

Aliases: A=`aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`, B=`bbbbbbb`, C=`ccccccc`, D=`ddddddd`; H/O=current HEAD/origin SHA7; W=`/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-timeout`.

```sh
# Capture completion evidence; refetch paginated threads; strip plan.
node "$BIN/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs" --worktree "$W" --option pr --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md
# Any nonzero: quote seal error, stop; no push.
git -C "$W" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 "$A"
git -C "$W" push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout
gh pr view 42 --repo acme/widget --json body
SCRATCH=$(mktemp)
# Decode body without trimming/substitution; write exact bytes,
# then blank line and block below.
gh pr edit 42 --repo acme/widget --body-file "$SCRATCH"
```

Scratch stays outside repository. Existing bytes: `Original description\n`.

```markdown
## Rework

Before: A (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42` in the rework checkout; the SHA is the portable handle and stays on origin because the push was not forced)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at H
Keeps: retry behavior
Changes: repair timeout
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-timeout; test-retry; lint; format; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
```

Expand aliases; append locations and resolutions:
T1 `fixed in D`; T2/T3 `fixed (task "<title>" complete; no single commit names <thread id>)`; T4–T6/T8 `still open`; T7 `declined - incompatible API`; omit resolved T9. Naming search: first-parent B..HEAD. Touches/path matches prove nothing. Empty fetch: `Threads: none`; failure: `Threads: not fetched (<reason>)`. All claims dropped: second line `supersedes the description above`; list each `No longer true: <claim>`.

### Independent checkpoint deltas

- **Withheld:** omit row 1; retain 2–6. `Withheld: push - push withheld: origin/fix-timeout is at O, local HEAD at H; a non-force push cannot land`. Append `(origin moved past the rework's base aaaaaaa)` only after separate A→origin proof; false adds nothing.
- Rows 2–6 map to ordinary Options 1–5. Bare `1`: ask for 2–6; `5`: keep branch/worktree, complete ship; `6`: list commits/branch/worktree and require exact `discard`; cleanup ownership rules apply, origin untouched.
- **History stop:** `PR branch history was rewritten: aaaaaaa is not an ancestor of HEAD; the rework must be re-merged, not rebased.`
- Missing prehead: stop naming `doc/specs/rework.md`. CLOSED: `PR #42 is CLOSED; the rework cannot be pushed to it.` Wrong head: name both branches. Exit 128: command error/output, never divergence.
- **Rejected push:** report once; no retry/body edit; return menu. **Body-edit failure:** retain push, print complete manual block and error; no completion. Success: verbatim seal stdout, complete ship, `gauntlet: done pushed`. No thread replies, merges, ticket changes, or member gate.
- **Minors:** independently dispatch F3 verbatim to implementer in W. Lint/format header supplies all four commands; sentinel supplies both task tests. Require successful post-fix evidence for every command: failing test-retry stops. All pass: commit `whole-diff minors fix`, re-audit, record full fix SHA, return full menu. Ordinary spec dispatches test-all only.

### Independent deltas

| Checkpoint | Difference |
|---|---|
| Origin divergence | Omit row 1; retain 2–6. `Withheld: push - origin/fix-timeout is at O, local HEAD at H; a non-force push cannot land`. |
| Origin ancestry comparison | Append `(origin moved past the rework's base A7)` only after separate positive proof; divergence alone proves nothing. |
| Withheld replies | `1`: clarify 2–6. `5`: Keep. `6`: typed `discard` confirmation, then ownership-governed cleanup. Rows 2–6 map to Options 1–5. |
| Broken prehead ancestry | Stop: `PR branch history was rewritten: A7 is not an ancestor of HEAD; the rework must be re-merged, not rebased.` |
| Invalid inputs/proofs | Missing prehead: name spec. CLOSED: `PR #42 is CLOSED; the rework cannot be pushed to it.` Wrong head: name both. Exit128: command error/output. |
| Rejected push | `gauntlet: stuck push-rejected`; no retry/body edit; preserve worktree; return menu. |
| Body failure/success | Failure: retain push, print manual block/error. Success: `gauntlet: done pushed`, verbatim seal stdout, complete ship. No member-closure question. |
| Minors F3 | Fresh implementer; verbatim F3; commands lint/format/test-timeout/test-retry, or sentinel-header task tests only. Require every successful result; retry failure stops. |

Passing minors: commit `whole-diff minors fix`, re-audit, record spent SHA, rerender full menu. Ordinary dispatch remains `test-all`. No code review, thread replies, merges, or ticket changes; scratch remains outside repository.
